name: ascii-lens
title: ASCII Lens
description: An image rendered as ASCII, with a circular lens that reveals the original.

useCases: Portfolio and product cards that reveal source artwork through an interactive lens.
limitations: Remote images must allow canvas pixel reads through CORS; otherwise ASCII sampling falls back to the original image.
requirements: Supply an image URL and alt text. Requires Motion, Canvas 2D, ResizeObserver, and IntersectionObserver. Remote images need anonymous CORS permission for ASCII sampling. Reduced motion cross-fades the lens in place at full size.

docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/ascii-lens.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.
